title: r402s/v0 heads listing request API message (the query of GET /gitvault/v1/vaults/:vault_id/heads?after_generation=&cursor=&limit=): after_generation is the REQUIRED verification anchor (constant across one page sequence), cursor is the OPTIONAL opaque continuation (omitted on the first request, the prior page's next_cursor echoed unchanged afterwards), limit is REQUIRED (a missing or malformed limit is a request-validation refusal, D186) and at most MAX_HEADS_PER_LISTING_PAGE; every query value is a string (D186; DRAFT rev 40)

heads_cursor.description: opaque continuation token — store and echo, never parse; bound by the platform to one vault and one after_generation
